Backend: 18/18 pytest checks pass (see /app/backend/tests/test_valuation_notifications.py) covering friendly_valuation_error() (5 patterns), _missing_valuation_products() (fail-open on unknown site / detects missing / passes when OK), _upsert_missing_planning_notification(notif_type='missing_valuation') dedupes correctly, mark_put_away_confirmed(site_id=...) rewrites recognized SAP valuation-missing text (G12FW@P2, generic pass-through, no-site pass-through), and the real POST /api/admin/material-sites/activate against SAFE pair P27175@P1 correctly returns planning_logistics/valuation both 'ok' AND uses the new type-aware branch (missing_valuation notif resolves only when valuation=='ok', missing_planning_data notif resolves when planning_logistics=='ok'; negative branch cross-verified by pure-logic replica). Screenshot confirmed. No regression on the existing 'Retry this order' top-level button or the 'Activate P3 for 100002693-C1' primary CTA.
critical_code_review_comments: stock_transfer_service.py: _missing_valuation_products swallows any DB/SAP exception silently (fail-open) - reasonable, but consider logging a warning so intermittent Valuation-lookup outages don't silently disable this proactive check indefinitely.
